text: Measure main page load time (Time to First Byte, TTFB) and verify it meets KPI
Test content above the fold display speed (First Contentful Paint, FCP) on desktop and mobile
Check full page load time (Fully Loaded), show hint if exceeds 3 seconds
Measure LCP (Largest Contentful Paint) on page with complex images
Test interactive element rendering speed (TTI — Time To Interactive)
Verify on mobile device first UI interaction takes no more than 2 seconds
Measure search form response speed when filtering large list
Enable slow network (3G simulation), verify quick main UI appearance (critical CSS/assets)
Test image lazy loading: ensure images load only when scrolled into view
Verify animations don't affect overall FPS on weak devices (animation throttling)
Measure absence of long JavaScript blocking main thread (Long Tasks threshold)
Test caching: verify repeat page load with cache faster than first open
Test CDN usage: resources load from CDN, latency minimal
Simulate multi-threaded media loading, verify UX display of spinners and progress bars
Test script performance during massive DOM operations (1000+ elements)
Test UI response with large number of simultaneous users (load testing / stress)
Verify theme/section switching happens in under 500ms
Run Lighthouse audit and ensure Performance Score doesn't drop below 85
Test memory: no memory leaks when navigating between sections
Verify PWA starts instantly from home screen (instant launch)
